title: Storyboard variety audit
what_it_does: Script that reads a storyboard table and flags repeated transitions/entrances/eases, uniform shot lengths, missing surprises and accent-colour overuse; remembers past films; fails on un-credited references.
when_to_use: Before building, to stop every video feeling the same.
why: No other repo has an automatic storyboard check. Stdlib only. Its table format must be kept.
